Container.Name: bawksync
Container.Overview: End-to-end encrypted sync server for bawkterm, an SSH, SFTP and Remote Desktop client. It stores only data your devices encrypted, so it cannot read your hosts, passwords or keys. On first start it creates a token and prints it once in the log (also saved in the data folder as "tokens").

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Encrypted database and the tokens file.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to have a token created on first start (shown once in the log, saved in the data folder). Or paste your own: 32+ random characters.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder (100 = users).
